svg.title: Q-NEXUS: before and after
svg.desc: Before: Item lists kept in separate Excel files. After: A BOQ inside each procurement with numbered revisions and a change history. Before: Vendor letters and replies in personal email and WhatsApp. After: Letters sent by SCM from the app and logged per vendor in Vendor Emails. Before: Decisions hard to trace afterwards. After: Every workflow action written to an append-only audit trail, with the reason. Before: Status known only by asking around. After: Dashboards per role that list what is waiting for whom and what is late.
svg.text: What changed for the people who use it.
